zh_cn.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.connect: 连接：先右键光枪支架，再右键FC主机；或依次右键两台双人街机
zh_cn.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.disconn: 断开：持数据线 Shift＋右键已连接的设备
zh_cn.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.permiss: 街机通讯需管理员权限并先结束游戏；AV电视线单独使用
zh_cn.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.av_cable.connect: 连接：持AV线依次右键主机和电视
zh_cn.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.av_cable.disconnec: 断开：持AV线 Shift＋右键主机或电视
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_not_c: 这台FC主机没有连接光枪支架数据线。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_power: 请先用数据线连接支架与 FC；连接后无需开机即可取枪。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_take_: 原光枪已取出，当前没有输入权限；开机后可持枪右键主机申请，不会自动开机。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_selec: 已选支架；60 秒内右键同维度 16 格内的 FC 连接。持数据线 Shift＋右键任一端断开。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_conne: 支架已连接 FC；放入已有光枪后可随时取出。取枪不会自动开机。

en_us.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.connect: Connect: right-click a gun stand then an FC console, or two dual cabinets in order
en_us.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.disconn: Disconnect: hold this cable and Shift-right-click a linked device
en_us.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.data_cable.permiss: Cabinet links require an administrator and idle games; TVs still use a separate AV cable
en_us.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.av_cable.connect: Connect: hold an AV cable and right-click the console and TV in order
en_us.tooltip.piq_fc_arcade.av_cable.disconnec: Disconnect: hold an AV cable and Shift-right-click either console or TV
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_not_c: This FC console has no gun-stand data cable attached.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_power: Connect the stand to FC with a data cable first; the console may remain off when taking the gun.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_take_: Original gun taken without input authority. Once powered on, right-click the console with it to request control; taking it never powers on the console.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_selec: Stand selected: click an FC within 16 blocks and 60 seconds. Hold a data cable and Shift-right-click either end to disconnect.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_conne: Stand connected to FC. Dock an existing gun and take it at any time; taking it does not power on the console.
